info.title: LightwaveRF Heating Universal API
info.description: Control and inspect LightwaveRF Smart Series heating context, rooms, features, feature writes, and historical data through the Link Plus Public API.

get.description: Retrieves multiple heating features from LightwaveRF Heating.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: features[]
parameters.description: The list of heating feature identifiers to read in one request.

parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.
